card.name: Inside interferon and triptan names
card.fires_on: The word piece that completes a drug name partway through, mostly the 'on' ending of interferon, the 'pt' in sumatriptan, and 'amine' in dihydroergotamine. Seen in label text about hepatitis C combination therapy and migraine nasal sprays.
